meaning:
ἐκ-καίω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּעַר ;]
1. to burn up.
2. to kindle. Pass., to burn: metaphorically, of the passions (cf. Sir.16:6, Job.3:17), Rom.1:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and…
